response.original_title: Legacies of Social Change: 100 Years of Professional Social Work in the U.S.
response.overview: In 1998, NASW led a national celebration to honor 100 years of social work accomplishments, helping individuals, families, and communities, and working for systemic changes to achieve social, political, and economic justice. The Centennial honored the social work profession's founders, champions and achievements in a yearlong celebration.
response.title: Legacies of Social Change: 100 Years of Professional Social Work in the U.S.
